subject: reasoning
question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. D is kept immediately above A. G is kept immediately above B. Only E is kept above C. Only two boxes are kept above D. G is not kept at the third position from the bottom. How many boxes are kept above G?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• D is kept immediately above A.
 
• G is kept immediately above B.
 
• Only E is kept above C.
 
• Only two boxes are kept above D.
 
• G is not kept at the third position from the bottom

The Final Arrangement is ,

 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
